senses.exPt: A viagem foi longa, mas valeu a pena.

senses.def: deserving respect, attention or support
senses.ex: This idea is worthy of serious attention.
senses.exPt: Esta ideia é digna de atenção séria.

senses.def: used with like to ask or offer something politely
senses.ex: Would you like a cup of tea?
senses.exPt: Você gostaria de uma xícara de chá?

senses.def: an injury to the body, such as a cut
senses.ex: The nurse cleaned the wound on his arm.
senses.exPt: A enfermeira limpou a ferida no braço dele.

senses.def: to argue with someone for a long time, often about something complicated
senses.ex: The two countries are still wrangling over the border.
senses.exPt: Os dois países ainda estão brigando por causa da fronteira.

senses.def: to cover a present with paper
senses.ex: I still need to wrap her birthday present.
senses.exPt: Ainda preciso embrulhar o presente de aniversário dela.

senses.def: to put something around someone or something
senses.ex: She wrapped a towel around her hair.
senses.exPt: Ela enrolou uma toalha no cabelo.

senses.def: a thin flat bread rolled around a filling
senses.ex: I had a chicken wrap for lunch.
senses.exPt: Comi um wrap de frango no almoço.

senses.def: paper or plastic used to cover something
senses.ex: She tore the wrapping off the present.
senses.exPt: Ela rasgou o embrulho do presente.

senses.def: a ship, car or plane that has been badly damaged or destroyed
senses.ex: Divers found the wreck of the ship on the sea floor.
senses.exPt: Mergulhadores encontraram os destroços do navio no fundo do mar.

senses.def: a person who is very tired, ill or nervous (informal)
senses.ex: After the long trip, I was a complete wreck.
senses.exPt: Depois da longa viagem, eu estava um caco.

senses.def: to destroy or badly damage something
senses.ex: The rain wrecked our plans for the weekend.
senses.exPt: A chuva arruinou nossos planos para o fim de semana.

senses.def: a metal tool for turning nuts and bolts
senses.ex: Can you pass me the wrench from the toolbox?
senses.exPt: Você pode me passar a chave inglesa da caixa de ferramentas?

senses.def: to pull something away suddenly and violently
senses.ex: He wrenched the bag out of her hands and ran.
senses.exPt: Ele arrancou a bolsa das mãos dela e saiu correndo.

senses.def: to injure a joint by twisting it suddenly
senses.ex: I wrenched my knee playing football on Saturday.
senses.exPt: Torci o joelho jogando futebol no sábado.

senses.def: the joint between your hand and your arm
senses.ex: She wore a silver watch on her left wrist.
senses.exPt: Ela usava um relógio de prata no pulso esquerdo.

senses.def: a watch that you wear on your wrist
senses.ex: My grandfather gave me his old wristwatch.
senses.exPt: Meu avô me deu o relógio de pulso antigo dele.

senses.def: to make words on paper or a screen
senses.ex: I write to my grandmother every month.
senses.exPt: Eu escrevo para a minha avó todo mês.

senses.def: a person whose job is writing books or stories
senses.ex: She wants to be a writer when she grows up.
senses.exPt: Ela quer ser escritora quando crescer.

senses.def: the activity or skill of writing
senses.ex: Writing is harder than reading for many students.
senses.exPt: A escrita é mais difícil que a leitura para muitos alunos.

senses.def: the way a person writes by hand
senses.ex: I can't read your writing, it's too small.
senses.exPt: Não consigo entender sua letra, é muito pequena.

senses.def: expressed in writing, not spoken
senses.ex: We have a written test tomorrow morning.
senses.exPt: Amanhã de manhã temos uma prova escrita.

senses.def: not correct
senses.ex: Sorry, I think you have the wrong number.
senses.exPt: Desculpe, acho que você ligou para o número errado.

senses.def: in a way that is not correct
senses.ex: Many people wrongly believe that bats are blind.
senses.exPt: Muita gente acredita erroneamente que os morcegos são cegos.

senses.def: unfairly, when someone has done nothing wrong
senses.ex: He spent ten years in prison after being wrongly convicted.
senses.exPt: Ele passou dez anos na prisão depois de ser condenado injustamente.

senses.def: showing amusement in a slightly mocking or dry way
senses.ex: She gave a wry smile when I mentioned her old job.
senses.exPt: Ela deu um sorriso irônico quando mencionei o antigo emprego dela.

senses.def: in a way that shows dry, slightly mocking humour
senses.ex: 'Well, that was a great success,' he said wryly.
senses.exPt: “Bom, isso foi um sucesso”, ele disse com ironia.
